nodes.label: Tesla Fleet test/live mode toggle removal
Rationale: Tesla has no sandbox, so the test/live toggle was theatre (both modes hit the same production URL)
Tesla Fleet OAuth tokens moved into Supabase Vault (tenants stores only secret UUIDs)
Rationale: plaintext tesla_fleet_api_token/refresh_token on tenants exposed every connected tenant's credentials to any service-role read
Rationale: connected tenants are force-disconnected because Round 1's missing offline_access scope left tokens expired with no refresh token
service_role-only SECURITY DEFINER RPC boundary for vault secrets (edge functions never touch the vault schema)
Hourly Tesla Supercharger charge sync across all Tesla-connected tenants
Rationale: run at :17 past the hour to avoid a thundering herd with the many jobs scheduled at :00
Gotcha: cron body hardcodes the project URL and a service_role JWT instead of current_setting('app.settings.supabase_url')
CMD licence-check polling fallback (every minute) for pending identity verifications
Rationale: Modives' webhook is not pointed at us yet; the poller is idempotent and a no-op when nothing is pending, so it is safe to leave running until unscheduled
AI verification of uploaded customer insurance documents (score, findings, extracted fields)
Attach-to-rental workflow with uploader/attacher audit trail (staff attaches a verified policy to a rental)
Tenant-folder-prefix storage isolation ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = tenant id) for insurance uploads
Gotcha: the insurance-verifications bucket is created public=true, so object URLs are readable regardless of the tenant-scoped SELECT policy
Auto-create one chat conversation per lead on insert
Rationale: ON CONFLICT inference against a PARTIAL unique index must repeat the predicate — without it every leads INSERT raised 42P10 and submit-application 500'd
Realtime publication of tenant_subscriptions so the portal billing gate reacts instantly
Rationale: without realtime the Finish Setup / block screen only updated on a page refresh after the Stripe webhook wrote the row
Per-tenant Vehicle Owners + Owner Payouts feature flag (default OFF, flipped by super admin)
Security-deposit pre-auth hold state machine (processing/held/captured/released/expired/refreshing/failed)
Rationale: 'processing' is an atomic claim sentinel (NULL->processing before calling Stripe) so concurrent invocations cannot both create real PaymentIntents on one card
Rationale: 'failed' lets the Stripe webhook surface a failed off-session hold to ops instead of the CHECK violation 500'ing place-deposit-hold and the hold silently never landing (R-68d116)
Per-rental security-deposit amount override with fallback to tenants.global_deposit_amount
Rationale: the new-rental form's deposit input was silently discarded — there was no column to store it, so place-deposit-hold and the UI kept using the global default
Auto-Extension rentals: opt-in prepaid rolling renewal billed UPFRONT each period
Tenant-level auto-extension policy: master toggle, default charge mode, lead hours, grace window, max retries
Two charge modes: auto_charge (saved card off-session) vs pay_link (emailed checkout each period)
auto_extend_pending_extension_id: the unpaid extension awaiting payment blocks creating another until settled
Partial scan index on auto_extend_next_charge_at (enabled and not paused) mirroring the PAYG accrual scan-index pattern
Rationale: additive-only design — PAYG, installments and normal rentals are untouched; built on top of the existing rental_extensions feature
pg_cron job: fire auto-extension charges every 15 minutes
Rationale: the edge function is idempotent — it acts only when auto_extend_next_charge_at <= now and advances the pointer in the same write, so overlapping ticks are harmless
Auto-extension reminder log: one row per pay-link / nudge / manual / auto-charge-receipt message actually sent
Per-rental nudge cadence config (enabled, interval days, max sends, count, last sent)
Paid-through-link tracking: reminder rows carry the Stripe checkout session id and flip to status='paid' when the linked payment lands
Daily 14:00 sweep re-sending unpaid auto-extension pay-links (empty body = sweep, body = manual send)
Flexible renewal cadence: period = auto_extend_interval_count x auto_extend_period_unit (every 10 days, every 2 weeks, ...)
Per-occurrence renewal schedule exceptions: skip or move a single date while keeping the cadence
Per-occurrence renewal config overrides (send agreement, buy insurance, custom email subject/body)
Grid-date (YYYY-MM-DD) keying convention: both exceptions and overrides are keyed by the date the cadence would land on
FIFO v2: an untagged generic payment may now waterfall onto Extension* charges
Rationale: the universal Collect Payment button allocated $0 against extension-only balances, stranding captured Stripe money as status='Credit' (rental R-63b168, globalmotiontransport)
Category waterfall: cat_order ranks Rental/Tax/Fees (1-7) ahead of Extension* (8-11) so originals are always paid first
Extension isolation invariant: a payment stamped to extension X may only pay X's charges plus non-extension charges
Rationale: refund-safe because per-extension paid_amount is computed from the CHARGE's extension_id, not from the paying payment's
Two allocation engines kept in step: the SQL FIFO function must match the apply-payment edge function's category list
Expense Tracker: vehicle costs and business-wide overhead in one ledger with vendor, payment method, receipt and recurrence
NULL vehicle_id means a company-wide/overhead expense; a set vehicle_id means a vehicle cost (and only then a vehicle_event is logged)
Per-tenant custom expense categories mapping a category name to a P&L bucket (Service vs Expenses)
Expense-to-P&L sync keyed by reference 'vexp:{expense_id}' (bucket resolved from the tenant's category config, legacy hardcoded fallback)
Rationale: pnl_entries.tenant_id backfilled from the linked vehicle — vehicle-expense P&L rows were silently excluded from tenant-scoped summaries
Gotcha: vehicle_expenses carried an allow-all policy but RLS was never enabled — retrofitted with tenant-scoped policies
Gotcha: the expense trigger wrote category 'Expenses' but chk_pnl_category_valid never allowed it, so those cost entries failed to insert
Tenant-folder scoping of the expense-receipts bucket (H2 hardening)
Rationale: the original policies authorised on bucket_id alone, so any authenticated user of any tenant could read or delete any receipt
Reflow historical P&L when an expense category's bucket changes (re-stamps every pnl_entry for that tenant+category)
Rationale: handle_vehicle_expense_pnl fires only on expense insert/update, so reclassifying a category left every past expense on the old bucket
In-function tenant authorization: the RPC raises unless the caller's tenant matches or they are a super admin (it is SECURITY DEFINER and granted to authenticated)
Category typing (business vs vehicle) drives the Add Expense dialog's dropdown filter; pnl_bucket retained so the P&L trigger is unchanged
Expenses capture a full timestamp (expense_at), backfilled from expense_date at midnight UTC
Rationale: expense_date is still written alongside expense_at so handle_vehicle_expense_pnl, which keys pnl_entries.entry_date off it, keeps working unchanged

Expense-to-P&L pipeline: an expense row resolves a tenant category to a P&L bucket, the trigger mirrors it into pnl_entries under 'vexp:{id}', and reclassification reflows history
